title: Koszul restriction eventually zero
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], f a finite sequence, and U the union of its principal opens [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Let E be in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. For every stage e and morphism phi from I_e to E whose restriction to U is zero, there exists b at least e such that the transition I_b to I_e followed by phi is zero.

proof.text: Apply the core affine derived equivalence and essential surjectivity of Q to get a module complex representing E. The factorization natural isomorphism identifies termwise tilde with E. presentationTilde gives quasi-coherence of every term.

Apply the stagewise additive equivalences and their restriction-zero compatibility. The existing affine Koszul-Cech comparison is an isomorphism. Its degree-zero homology map, preceded by the inverse homology localization isomorphism, is therefore injective. The restriction-zero equation implies that the Hom-complex colimit class is zero.

The proved filtered module-complex homology criterion gives a later transition killing the stage class. Naturality of the stagewise additive equivalences identifies this with the class of precomposition by koszulOpenMap. Additive equivalences preserve zero and are injective, proving the desired equality.
